goal: Verify that a user can create a new account, navigate to the calendar view, and select a specific date in January 2026 to view associated memos.

findings.instruction: In the year view, locate the 'JAN' calendar grid and click on the date '1' to select January 1, 2026.
findings.title: Year view modal closed unexpectedly, preventing date selection
findings.description: The test step intended to click a date in the year view (January 1, 2026), but the year view modal is no longer visible in the 'AFTER' screenshot. Instead, the app reverted to the single-month view (showing December 2025). This indicates the year view modal closed prematurely or failed to remain open, blocking the user from selecting the target date.
findings.evidence: In the 'BEFORE' screenshot, the year view modal is visible with all 12 months of 2026 displayed. In the 'AFTER' screenshot, the modal is gone, and the calendar widget shows 'December 2025' instead of the year view. The test action failed with a TimeoutError, suggesting the target element was not found because the modal closed.
reproduction_steps: Navigate to the dashboard after logging in.
Click 'June 2026' to open the year view modal.
Attempt to click on a date in the January 2026 grid within the year view.
Observe that the year view modal closes unexpectedly, reverting to the single-month view.
